states: the Modkit's D98 states (their drive and config: LOCAL/03-heavy-scenes.md)
pad: the keyboard pad on port 2; scancodes are the D98 config's map (a 81, y 44)
start: stop, loadvm <tag> (stays paused), write the lines, then xemu-frame-advance to each stop
lines_count_from: the paused load: +N is N vblanks after it
hash: sha256[:12] of all guest RAM from xemu-dump-ram with gpu-sync false; bench-det's f<N>= value is the same sha256's first 16 digits
fight_rule: walk at one stick heading for W vblanks, stop, then A (81) down 4 vblanks every 16 vblanks to +600; job 03-a keeps the first heading (forward first) and W (60, 120, 180, 240) whose run lands an apply_damage (0x44640) on a critter other than the player

fight_candidates.order: every W for the first heading, then the next heading
fight_candidates.lines: '+2 axis lx <lx>' and '+2 axis ly <ly>' (each only if not 0; 6 decimals), the same axes '+<2+W> axis .. 0.000000', then '+<k> down 81' and '+<k+4> up 81' for k = 4+W, 20+W, ... while k+4 < 600

check_hooks.note: xemu-hooks-set after the paused load, before the lines; pcs decimal: 341840 = 0x53750 (load_level; [esp+8] the path), 280128 = 0x44640 (apply_damage; [esp+4] the critter, [esp+8] the new HP; [pd+0xC0] the player's critter). Collect only: the RAM is bench-det's
